tools.name: get_price_changes

tools.description: Use this when someone wants the best FPL Wildcard or Free Hit squad for any gameweek, or the best FPL team right now, built by fplcopilot's optimiser within £100m and FPL squad rules. tools.name: get_mini_league
tools.description: Use this for an FPL mini-league or a manager's rivals in it: standings, the gap to the leader, and rivals' captains and differential picks. Without a league ID it lists the manager's leagues to choose from.

tools.name: get_mini_league_odds
tools.description: Use this when an FPL manager asks their chances (or odds) of winning their mini-league: each manager's win and top-3 probability from 5,000 simulations of the rest of the season.

tools.name: get_gameweek_review
tools.description: Use this to review an FPL manager's gameweek: points vs the average, captain result, bench points and transfers, plus how lucky their season has been against fplcopilot's expected points.

tools.name: get_predicted_lineups
tools.description: Use this for predicted Premier League starting XIs and team news for the next FPL gameweek (who starts, who is injured or rotated), from fplcopilot's expected minutes.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: App-only. The fplcopilot card's Share button calls this with the card's share token (and the card, used only if it is exactly what the token signs); it publishes that card, as this server made it, to a public fplcopilot.com page and returns the link. Nothing else can be published.

tools.name: get_player_breakdown
tools.description: App-only. The fplcopilot card calls this when the user taps a player, to open that player's card: expected points by gameweek and by source (minutes, goals, assists, clean sheets, bonus), fixtures and news.

tools.name: get_player_breakdowns
tools.description: App-only. The fplcopilot card calls this as it opens, to load the player cards of the players it shows, so a tap opens one at once.

tools.name: search_teams
tools.description: App-only. The team card calls this as the user types their team's name, their name or their team ID.

tools.name: get_plan_paths
tools.description: App-only. The transfer plan card calls this while its run is still finding paths, to show each path as it lands.

tools.name: get_manager_squad
tools.description: App-only. The mini-league card calls this when the user taps a rival, to show that manager's squad on a pitch.

tools.name: get_deadline
tools.description: Use this for any question about the Fantasy Premier League (FPL) deadline or the time left to make transfers: the next gameweek's deadline from FPL's live schedule, and how long is left.

tools.name: search_guides

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_captain_picks, get_gameweek_review · Private data: create_share_link · Public sink: create_share_link · Destructive: get_plan_paths.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_captain_picks, get_gameweek_review · Private data: create_share_link · Public sink: create_share_link · Destructive: get_plan_paths

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
